description: No VPC exists in any region except the project VPC in us-east-1, and no default VPC exists anywhere

matrix_rows.gap: The network population half: no VPC beyond the project's, so the egress rules judged by cna-rnt-cfg-aws-no-open-egress are all of them. GCP's Cloud Run job has no VPC, so no egress firewall applies; it reaches AWS over the internet by design.
